remarks: Enjoy effortless living in this centrally located Greenwich end unit townhouse featuring 3 bedrooms and 3.1 baths across three beautifully designed levels. Vaulted ceilings and an open floor plan create a bright, airy feel, with oversized windows filling the home with natural light. The first floor bedroom is beautifully positioned on the main level, offering comfort and convenience with easy access to the home's primary living spaces. Upstairs, two spacious ensuite bedrooms provide privacy and refined comfort, each thoughtfully designed with generous closets and well appointed baths. The lower level offers exceptional additional living space, perfect for a media room, gym, lounge, or recreation area allowing for seamless entertaining and everyday enjoyment.  As an end unit, the home benefits from enhanced light and added privacy. A two car garage and a prime in town location close to shops, dining, and the train complete this exceptional offering. Luxury, convenience, and turnkey townhouse living in the heart of Greenwich.
